title: Phase 6.2.39-R1 — Full-Universe Routing Logic Audit Report

verdict_constraints.disclaimer: ROUTING_LOGIC_CONFIRMED validates the mathematical and policy integrity of the multi-dimensional routing matrix. It does NOT authorize production activation or user testing.

decision_tree_audit.step_1_semantic_evaluation: evaluateCandidateSenses() computes top_score (S1), second_score (S2), and margin (Delta = S1 - S2). S1 >= 0.65 and Delta >= 0.15 => SEMANTIC_MATCH_CONFIDENT; S1 >= 0.40 and not confident => SEMANTIC_MATCH_AMBIGUOUS; else SEMANTIC_MATCH_NO_EVIDENCE.
decision_tree_audit.step_2_auto_candidate_gate: Requires ALL of: isSemConf (S1 >= 0.65, Delta >= 0.15) AND hasThai AND hasExample (EXAMPLE_EXACT or EXAMPLE_INFLECTED) AND hasIpaConfirmed (CONFIRMED) AND hasSense AND !hasCefrConflict AND !hasSourceConflict AND hasLexicon. Zero hidden blockers permitted.
decision_tree_audit.step_3_review_required_gate: Requires: !hasCefrConflict AND !hasSourceConflict AND hasThai AND hasSense AND hasLexicon AND (isSemConf || isSemAmb) AND (hasExample || example_status === EXAMPLE_REVIEW). Filters out evidence-absence gaps, sending only genuine editorial ambiguities to human queue.
decision_tree_audit.step_4_hold_gate: Fail-closed fallback for all units failing Steps 2 and 3 (missing examples, weak semantics S1 < 0.40, CEFR conflicts, missing Thai translations, or missing WordNet synsets).
decision_tree_audit.step_5_primary_blocker_priority: Deterministic cascading hierarchy: CEFR_CONFLICT > THAI_NOT_FOUND > SENSE_NOT_FOUND > EXAMPLE_NOT_FOUND > SEMANTIC_NO_EVIDENCE > POLYSEMY_UNRESOLVED > IPA_NOT_FOUND > IPA_MULTI_VARIANT > LEXICON_NOT_FOUND > SOURCE_CONFLICT > OTHER_BLOCKER > NONE.

policy_nature.assessment: All 3,712 units moved from REVIEW_REQUIRED to HOLD were caused by genuine evidence absence (1,992 missing examples, 1,545 missing semantic definition overlap S1 < 0.40, and 175 missing senses). Not a single unit was moved into HOLD merely to reduce human workload.

auto_to_hold_decomposition.root_cause: SEMANTIC_NO_EVIDENCE: All 1,035 units were monosemous dictionary entries accepted by Phase 6.2.36 that failed the calibrated definition keyword overlap gate (S1 < 0.40). Correctly quarantined to prevent ungrounded single-translation hallucination.

auto_to_review_decomposition.root_cause: SEMANTIC_MATCH_AMBIGUOUS: All 585 units achieved moderate semantic scores (0.40 <= S1 < 0.65 or margin < 0.15). Properly routed to human review rather than automatic promotion.

key_findings: MATCHER_LIMITATION accounts for only 36 units (0.81%). The regex and tokenization matcher logic is fundamentally robust.
SOURCE_DATA_GAP accounts for 1,729 units (38.74%): WordNet synsets contain 0 example sentences.
QUALITY_REJECTED accounts for 1,193 units (26.73%): WordNet example fragments fail minimum length (4 words) or punctuation rules.
MORPHOLOGY_UNRESOLVED accounts for 808 units (18.10%): Sentences contain inflected forms that rule-based lemmatizer did not map back to headwords.
TRUE_SOURCE_GAP accounts for 697 units (15.62%): WordNet examples illustrate a co-synonym, leaving the target lemma unattested.

unsupported_projection_audit.rigorous_conclusion: Example expansion in Phase 6.2.40 can directly unlock at most 365 units into AUTO_CANDIDATE.
